title: Operator Hatchery: autogenerate admin utilities and safe-deploy workflow
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Build an "operator hatchery" service that autogenerates small, audited admin utilities (adminlets) from declarative runbook snippets and exposes a safe-deploy workflow. Goal: enable SREs and support engineers to create one-off repairlets and verified runbook tasks quickly while preserving audit, RBAC, and idempotency guarantees.
acceptance_criteria: Operator Hatchery can ingest runbook snippets (YAML) and produce a namespaced adminlet that runs in the sandboxed runtime
Generated adminlets include automatic telemetry hooks and token-level cost tags
Safe-deploy workflow provides dry-run, canary execution, and automatic rollback on policy match
All adminlet executions are logged to the audit stream and visible in Console -> Playbook Runs
Security review completed and gating KMS/HSM secrets are not embedded in generated artifacts
planned_steps: Define runbook snippet schema and type system (actions, inputs, checks, timeouts)
Prototype generator that maps snippets to task templates and a containerized adminlet
Integrate sandbox runtime (ephemeral sidecar) and enforce capability restrictions
Wire telemetry: execution spans, token counts, error categorization, and cost attribution
Add safe-deploy: dry-run, canary (10%), staged ramp, and automated rollback triggers
Add Console surface for publishing, reviewing, and revoking generated adminlets
Run internal dogfood on 3 real incidents and capture feedback
notes: 2026-02-16: Kickoff meeting. Product/Design alignment: we should prioritize least-privilege capabilities over broad convenience. PM request to surface user previews in Console.
2026-02-22: Chose YAML-first snippet schema to be human-editable; trade-off is more schema validation work on ingestion. Added strict input typing to reduce blast radius.
2026-03-01: Prototype finished — generator outputs a lightweight go-based adminlet image + manifest. Found race in KV cache flush during canary, created reproducible test in harness.

2026-03-04: Security review (initial) requested. Claire Jiang reviewed design notes; main concern: generated images must never include long-lived credentials. Plan: use ephemeral tokens minted by Agent Broker.
2026-03-06: UX feedback from Maya Chen: Console publish flow needs reviewer assignment and reason for change fields. Added reviewer and rationale to manifest.
2026-03-08: Integration test failing intermittently under load due to scheduling fairness in the sandbox controller. Investigating preemption and queue priorities.
2026-03-09: PR opened for generator and console hooks. See PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-hatchery/pull/412

2026-03-10: Running internal dogfood on non-critical incident: adminlet executed successfully with dry-run then canary; rollback triggered by failed post-check. Telemetry emitted as expected. Next: improve human-readable failure reasons in Console
